† [כְּרַז] vb. denom.
Haph. make proclamation (poss. directly dependent on κῆρυξ (D§ 37, p. 146 (2nd ed. 183) K l.c. M 67), but even then formed as denom.; cf. 𝔗 כְּרַז, NH כָּרַז, Syriac ܟܪܙ Af. Ethpe., so Chr-Pal. SchwallyIdiot. 46 SchulthLex. 97);—Pf. 3 mpl. הַכְרִ֫זוּ Dn 5:29, c. עַל pers. concerning.
